name: 1425457f-type-binding-order
description: Z8: таблица привязок редактора типа на row-reorder — ▲/▼ нет, порядок DnD/Alt/меню (включая привязку стороны «назначение»), черновик до «Применить и закрыть», порядок переживает переоткрытие; навигация ↑/↓/Enter.

steps.name: open-network-again
steps.probe: (() => { const item=document.querySelector('.networks-list .network-item'); if(item !== null) item.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: seed-z8
steps.probe: (async () => { const nid='{{networkId}}'; const type=await window.etn.types.createThoughtType(nid,{ name:'Тип Z8' }); const ids=[]; for (const name of ['Альфа','Бета','Гамма']) { const p=await window.etn.propertyRegistry.create(nid,{ name, value_type:'text' }); const b=await window.etn.types.createTypeProperty(nid,'thought_type',type.id,{ mode:'attach', property_id:p.id, required:false, position:undefined }); ids.push(b.id); } const lp=await window.etn.propertyRegistry.create(nid,{ name:'Зет-связь', value_type:'link', name_forward:'исходит от', name_reverse:'ведёт к' }); const tb=await window.etn.types.createTypeProperty(nid,'thought_type',type.id,{ mode:'attach', property_id:lp.id, required:false, position:undefined, side:'target' }); ids.push(tb.id); window.__z8={ typeId:type.id, initial:ids, linkProperty:lp.id }; return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: open-net-menu
steps.probe: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((x)=>x.title==='Меню мыслесети'); if(!b) return 'no-button'; b.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: open-thought-types
steps.probe: (() => { const it=[...document.querySelectorAll('.menu .menu-item')].find((x)=>(x.textContent||'').includes('Типы мыслей')); if(!it) return 'no-item'; it.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: open-z8-editor
steps.probe: (() => { const row=[...document.querySelectorAll('.ui-tree-row')].find((r)=>(r.textContent||'').includes('Тип Z8')); if(!row) return 'no-row'; row.setAttribute('data-z8-row','1'); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: open-properties-tab
steps.probe: (() => { const top=[...document.querySelectorAll('.dialog-backdrop')].pop(); const b=[...(top?.querySelectorAll('.ui-tablist button') ?? [])].find((x)=>(x.textContent||'').includes('Свойства')); if(!b) return 'no-tab'; b.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: install-helpers
steps.probe: (() => { window.__z8ui={ top:()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('.dialog-backdrop')].pop(), rows:()=>[...(window.__z8ui.top()?.querySelectorAll('.te-split tr[data-row-id]') ?? [])], ids:()=>window.__z8ui.rows().map((r)=>r.getAttribute('data-row-id')), nameCell:(n)=>window.__z8ui.top().querySelector('.te-split tr[data-row-id]:nth-child('+n+') td') }; return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: collapse-inherited-group
steps.probe: (() => { const h=[...document.querySelectorAll('.te-split .group-header')].find((x)=>(x.textContent||'').includes('унаследованные')); if(!h) return 'no-header'; h.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: own-table-fits-without-scroll
steps.waitFor: (() => { const wraps=[...document.querySelectorAll('.te-split .admin-table-wrap')]; const own=wraps[wraps.length-1]; return own !== undefined && own.scrollHeight <= own.clientHeight + 2; })()

steps.name: no-arrow-buttons
steps.probe: (() => { const top=window.__z8ui.top(); const buttons=[...(top?.querySelectorAll('.te-split button') ?? [])].filter((b)=>['▲','▼'].includes((b.textContent||'').trim())); return buttons.length; })()

steps.name: initial-ui-order
steps.probe: window.__z8ui.ids().join(',') === window.__z8.initial.join(',')

steps.name: initial-server-order
steps.probe: (async () => { const own=(await window.etn.types.listTypeProperties('{{networkId}}','thought_type',window.__z8.typeId)).filter((x)=>!x.inherited).map((x)=>x.id); return own.join(',') === window.__z8.initial.join(','); })()

steps.name: checkbox-toggled
steps.probe: (() => { const r=window.__z8ui.rows()[0]; return r?.querySelector('input[type=checkbox]')?.checked ?? null; })()

steps.name: enter-focused-default-editor
steps.probe: (() => { const r=window.__z8ui.rows()[0]; const cell=r?.querySelector('.prop-default-cell'); return cell !== undefined && cell !== null && cell.contains(document.activeElement); })()

steps.name: current-is-row-2
steps.probe: (() => { const cur=window.__z8ui.top()?.querySelector('.te-split tr.prop-row-current'); return cur?.getAttribute('data-row-id') === window.__z8.initial[1]; })()

steps.name: drag-third-to-top
steps.probe: (() => { const rows=window.__z8ui.rows(); const src=rows[2]; const tgt=rows[0]; const cell=src.querySelector("td"); const a=cell.getBoundingClientRect(); const b=tgt.getBoundingClientRect(); const fromX=Math.round(a.left+20); const fromY=Math.round(a.top+a.height/2); const toX=Math.round(b.left+80); const toY=Math.round(b.top+4); cell.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent("pointerdown",{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,button:0,clientX:fromX,clientY:fromY,pointerId:7})); for (let i=1;i<=10;i+=1) { const y=Math.round(fromY+(toY-fromY)*i/10); src.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent("pointermove",{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,button:0,clientX:toX,clientY:y,pointerId:7})); } src.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent("pointerup",{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,button:0,clientX:toX,clientY:toY,pointerId:7})); return "ok"; })()

steps.name: open-row-4-menu
steps.probe: (() => { const cell=window.__z8ui.nameCell(4); if(!cell) return 'no-cell'; const r=cell.getBoundingClientRect(); cell.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,clientX:Math.round(r.left+20),clientY:Math.round(r.top+6)})); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: row-menu-items
steps.probe: [...document.querySelectorAll('.menu .menu-item')].map((x)=>(x.textContent||'').trim()).filter((x)=>x!==''&&x!=='—')

steps.name: menu-move-up
steps.probe: (() => { const it=[...document.querySelectorAll('.menu .menu-item')].find((x)=>(x.textContent||'').trim()==='Переместить выше'); if(!it) return 'no-item'; it.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: server-still-initial-before-apply
steps.probe: (async () => { const own=(await window.etn.types.listTypeProperties('{{networkId}}','thought_type',window.__z8.typeId)).filter((x)=>!x.inherited).map((x)=>x.id); return own.join(',') === window.__z8.initial.join(','); })()

steps.name: apply-and-close
steps.probe: (() => { const top=window.__z8ui.top(); const b=[...(top?.querySelectorAll('button') ?? [])].find((x)=>(x.textContent||'').trim()==='Применить и закрыть'); if(!b) return 'no-button'; b.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: server-order-after-apply
steps.probe: (async () => { const own=(await window.etn.types.listTypeProperties('{{networkId}}','thought_type',window.__z8.typeId)).filter((x)=>!x.inherited).map((x)=>x.id); return own.join(',') === [window.__z8.initial[2],window.__z8.initial[1],window.__z8.initial[3],window.__z8.initial[0]].join(','); })()

steps.name: reopen-z8-editor
steps.probe: (() => { const row=[...document.querySelectorAll('.ui-tree-row')].find((r)=>(r.textContent||'').includes('Тип Z8')); if(!row) return 'no-row'; row.setAttribute('data-z8-row','1'); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: open-properties-tab-again
steps.probe: (() => { const top=[...document.querySelectorAll('.dialog-backdrop')].pop(); const b=[...(top?.querySelectorAll('.ui-tablist button') ?? [])].find((x)=>(x.textContent||'').includes('Свойства')); if(!b) return 'no-tab'; b.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: order-survives-reopen
steps.probe: (() => { const top=[...document.querySelectorAll('.dialog-backdrop')].pop(); const ids=[...(top?.querySelectorAll('.te-split tr[data-row-id]') ?? [])].map((r)=>r.getAttribute('data-row-id')); return ids.join(',') === [window.__z8.initial[2],window.__z8.initial[1],window.__z8.initial[3],window.__z8.initial[0]].join(','); })()

steps.name: cancel-editor
steps.probe: (() => { const top=[...document.querySelectorAll('.dialog-backdrop')].pop(); const b=[...(top?.querySelectorAll('button') ?? [])].find((x)=>(x.textContent||'').trim()==='Отмена'); if(!b) return 'no-button'; b.click(); return 'ok'; })()
